title: Source-Account Delta Agents
summary: Implementation is active. Gmail sync completion and Slack message/mention ingress wake the exact account immediately, while active-job dedupe collapses bursts and the one-minute schedule remains anti-entropy. Discovery and closure both use sealed provider-to-model delta handoffs; empty deltas cost zero model calls and non-empty reasoning remains account-scoped.
next_action: Deploy the complete account-worker topology, prove production parity and runtime health, then cut ordinary Chief acquisition over to persisted results.

verification.notes: Plain spectacula invocation sets final_vetting off. Development and test compilation with warnings-as-errors pass; source-account discovery, closure, completion, and periodic tests pass, Gmail advisor passes 22/22, Gmail ingress handler passes 4/4, and the exact Slack ingress wake test passes. Two stale connector expectations encountered during verification were deliberately updated to assert the production query contract and redacted rate-limit error. Broad suites remain intentionally skipped under repository policy.

resume_context.last_completed_step: Moved account closure acquisition into the provider lane with a bounded encrypted model handoff, zero-model empty-delta settlement, and cursor advancement only after completion reasoning settles.
pending_steps: Prove the account-worker topology and runtime health in production.
Cut ordinary Chief cycles over to persisted account-worker results after production parity.
resume_context.notes: Use exact durable background assignments as ephemeral OTP agents; do not create a parallel fleet of long-lived Agent rows.

history.note: Captured the user's per-Gmail/per-Slack discovery and closure design against the existing exact OTP runtime.
Started the first efficiency slice: bundle-first Slack follow-through.
Bundle-first Slack follow-through, self-authored todo admission, and source-evidence closure regression coverage pass.
Exact requested source scopes now intersect with live accounts and service capabilities; focused SourceScope and acquisition tests pass.
New sourced todos carry exact connected-account lineage and all four Gmail/Slack role cursors reject rewinds independently.
Exact account closure jobs run on a one-minute anti-entropy cadence, consume only closure deltas, skip the model on empty bundles, and leave cursors unchanged on unsettled evaluation.

Per-account discovery now runs as a provider-lane delta acquisition with an encrypted bounded model handoff; supplied Gmail bundles are authoritative, quiet cycles use zero model calls, and reasoning is capped at one high-intelligence todo call.

Gmail incremental-sync completion and Slack message/mention ingress now wake the exact account workers immediately; burst events collapse through durable active-job dedupe and closure only wakes when account-scoped open work exists.

Closure now acquires account deltas in the provider lane and seals non-empty bundles for model-lane completion; quiet cycles use zero model calls and cursors advance only after settled reasoning. Legacy direct closure jobs remain executable solely for revision-drain compatibility.
